notes.title: Transfer progress between Nintendo Switch and PC
notes.content:
This update allows you to transfer your progress between Induction on PC and Nintendo Switch.

To transfer progress:
[list]
[*] Open the pause menu on the device you want to transfer progress [b]from[/b]
[*] Go to the Data screen, and note down the 8 character code at the bottom of the screen
[*] Open the pause menu on the device you want to transfer progress [b]to[/b]
[*] Go to the Data screen, and enter the 8 character code you noted down
[/list]
All levels unlocked on the first device will now be unlocked on the second device. Solution replays will not though be transferred.

If you experience any problems with this update, please let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/381890/discussions/]discussion board[/url], or contact me at support@inductiongame.com.

notes.title: Induction Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
This update moves Induction to the latest stable version of the Unity engine, which means the desktop version of Induction will be in sync with ports to other platforms, coming later this year.

Unfortunately this means version 1.1.0 will not support some older operating systems. If you're affected by this, the "legacy" 1.0.5 version of Induction will still be available - right click Induction in your Steam library, select "Properties...", select "Betas", then select the "legacy" branch.

This update makes a few other small changes.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Minor redesign the the level select interface
[*] Game is no longer letterboxed to 16:9
[*] Faster loading
[*] Additional translations to German and Korean
[*] Credits are accessible through the "About" menu
[*] When using a gamepad, the right stick can be used to control time flow, in addition to shoulder buttons
[*] Time portals more accurately show revealed timeline
[*] Fix a bug that could cause replays to sometimes not play
[/list]

If you experience any problems with this update, please let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/381890/discussions/]discussion board[/url], or contact me at support@inductiongame.com.

notes.title: Tim Shiel's soundtrack out now
notes.content:
The Induction soundtrack, by Melbourne-based composer, producer, and multi-instrumentalist Tim Shiel, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/519070/]is out now[/url].

The soundtrack combines the game’s signature theme with a collection of bespoke ambient works inspired by the game’s causality-bending premise. 

Induction’s sound world is playful and tricky, constantly shapeshifting and alternating from minimalism to maximalism. 

The soundtrack is available to buy now as [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/519070/]DLC for Induction[/url].

-Bryan

notes.title: Induction is a time-travel puzzle game that s out now
notes.content:
What s your favourite thing about spacetime? Mine is… that it goes… wobbly. Excuse me, the weirdest feeling just came over me. Never mind. Induction [official site], a new time-travel puzzle game from Bryan Gale is out today, which aims to rewire how you think about cause and effect. I won t pretend to understand what s happening in the cube and colour-filled video below, but it might be very clever.
… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Paradoxical puzzler Induction pegged for February 7
notes.content: I just spent the last few minutes trying to work out how you play Induction [official site] – “an abstract puzzle game about time travel and paradoxes” – by watching the trailer. It’s very elegant-looking and I got as far as feeling like maybe there was an element of P.B Winterbottom in terms of time faffery but I eventually had to give up and started reading the press release instead. I’ve got until the Feb 7th release date to get to grips with it! … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Tim Shiel creating Induction's soundtrack
notes.content:
I'm hugely delighted to announce that Tim Shiel will be creating all that you hear in Induction. Tim previously created the soundtracks to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/292600/]Duet[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/357460/]GameLoading: Rise of the Indies[/url], and he'll now be turning his considerable talents to giving Induction its musical heart and soul.

As well as a decade long career creating innovative and richly detailed electronic music, Tim performs as part of Gotye's live band, and is the host of Something More on Australia's Double J radio.

You can hear Tim's past work on his [url=http://soundcloud.com/timshiel]Soundcloud page[/url], and the first listen of his work for Induction in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DhuMC7nD2uo]new trailer[/url] released today.

-Bryan
